label: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B — text to video (local, Apache-2.0)
notes: Derived from the official ComfyUI Wan 2.2 5B example (UNETLoader / CLIPLoader / VAELoader / ModelSamplingSD3 / CLIPTextEncode x2 / Wan22ImageToVideoLatent / KSampler / VAEDecode) with the current core video nodes CreateVideo -> SaveVideo (mp4). Defaults: 1280x704, 121 frames, 24 fps. NOT executed against a live ComfyUI by the repository authors: the adapter checks every class_type against the connected server's /object_info before use, ComfyUI rejects unknown inputs loudly with node_errors, and the setup screen's functional test is what proves the engine end to end. Override sampler_name / scheduler / clip_type / width / height / length here or from the API if your ComfyUI build prefers other values; all of them are declared inputs precisely so they can be changed without editing the graph.
